summary: fast-glob typosquat installs attacker SSH key into ~/.ssh/authorized_keys at install time
details: fast-glob-fast is a typosquat of the legitimate fast-glob package (its package.json reuses the upstream repository field mrmlnc/fast-glob). Its package.json declares a postinstall hook (`node scripts/postinstall-test.mjs`) that, on Linux, macOS, and Windows, appends a hardcoded ssh-ed25519 public key labeled 'dkhrustalev' to the installing user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, granting the key holder persistent remote SSH access to any host that runs `npm install`. The same script then collects username, hostname, MAC address, platform, and arch and POSTs them (with an optional bearer token) to a URL read from the FAST_GLOB_FAST_EVENT_URL environment variable, reporting successful implantation to an operator-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
